headline: President announces NT$10,000 universal cash handout next year; Blue-White camp accuses double standards | Politics
summary: President Lai Ching-te announced that NT$10,000 in cash will be distributed to all citizens next year to share in economic growth. The opposition KMT accused the ruling DPP of applying double standards on fiscal discipline.
why: Universal cash handouts are fiscal measures that affect government spending, public finances and domestic consumption in Taiwan.
